edges.reason: Constructor writes the hard-coded Round struct into round_[1].
getTimeLeft mutates round_[_rID].end based on the current time.
getTimeLeft reads the current round id rID_.
getCurrentRoundInfo reads and writes round_[_rID] fields.
getCurrentRoundInfo reads the current round id rID_.
Any caller (msg.sender) can send ETH through the payable fallback.
msg.sender triggers the payable buyXid entry point and becomes the player.
msg.sender triggers the payable buyXaddr entry point.
withdraw has no owner/access-control check, so any msg.sender can drain the contract balance to the fixed addresses.
msg.sender triggers the payable registerNameXID entry point.
msg.sender triggers the payable registerNameXaddr entry point.
msg.sender triggers the payable registerNameXname entry point.
getTimeLeft derives the returned value and stored round end from block.timestamp, making outcome miner/timestamp dependent.
getCurrentRoundInfo computes and writes round_[_rID].end from block.timestamp.
withdraw executes the external value transfers to aff and aff2 before returning, exposing state-change-then-call ordering.
The external transfer can invoke code in the recipient contract, which may call back into withdraw.
withdraw computes _one as this.balance/2, a balance-dependent division.
iWantXKeys performs _keys.mul(...)/1000000000000000000 arithmetic on caller input.
The _keys parameter flows directly into the multiplication arithmetic of iWantXKeys.
